why_points: The pick: Carries higher 19.5 on Underdog. Each pick has to win 56% of the time for a typical entry to make money; the sportsbooks' fair view (draftkings 21.5, moved to this line) is 61%.
Other apps: PrizePicks 21. This is the best number for the higher side.
Game log, most recent first: 20, 16, 29, 19, 17, 7, 13, 12. Weighted average 18.0; went higher than 19.5 in 2 of 8 games (36% recency-weighted).
Trending up: last 3 games average 21.7 vs 13.6 in the games before.
How much he swings: game to game he typically moves about ±5.9, so the line is 0.3 of those swings above his average (standard deviations) — a modest gap.
Projection: we expect 19.4 carries on average; in a typical game 17.8 (a few big games pull the average up, so the typical game is what we compare with the line) — 1.7 below the line.

Keeping it honest: on their own, recent games (form) say 52% and the matchup 58%. The sportsbooks are usually close to right, and these methods have only partly beaten them (weights measured on NFL week 2), so we pull them most of the way toward the market: form 60%, matchup 61%.
Bottom line: we give it 61% to win and it needs 56%. The edge is the difference: +4.9 points; that works out to about +9¢ per $1 bet over the long run.
